idx_projects_repository_workspace_id.name: idx_projects_repository_workspace_id
idx_projects_repository_workspace_id.where: "projects"."repository_workspace_id" IS NOT NULL AND "projects"."deleted_at" IS NULL

idx_tasks_active_automation_run_id.name: idx_tasks_active_automation_run_id
idx_tasks_active_automation_run_id.where: "tasks"."automation_run_id" IS NOT NULL AND "tasks"."deleted_at" IS NULL

idx_workspaces_local_path.name: idx_workspaces_local_path
idx_workspaces_local_path.where: "workspaces"."location" = 'local' AND "workspaces"."untracked_at" IS NULL AND "workspaces"."path" IS NOT NULL

idx_workspaces_remote_path.name: idx_workspaces_remote_path
idx_workspaces_remote_path.where: "workspaces"."location" = 'remote' AND "workspaces"."untracked_at" IS NULL AND "workspaces"."path" IS NOT NULL
